name: – Victor Negrescu, Siegfried Mureşan – § 59 – Am 36
title: REPORT on the implementation of the Recovery and Resilience Facility
part_text: 59. Recalls the fact that Parliament’s role is laid down in Articles 25 and 26 of the RRF Regulation; reiterates that, based on this regulation, Parliament has no role in the design of NRRPs and is not consulted on payment requests; emphasises, in this regard, that Parliament must always act within the remit of its competences;
